extras.note: For these product ids the core asks for the real BIOS and warns "This game requires a real BIOS" when it boots HLE.
Every MIL-CD disc asks for the real BIOS, as the product ids above do.

flycast.note: The area symbols and flycast_region set the console region written into dc_nvmem.bin. One boot ROM serves every region.

dc-ip-bin.description: IP.BIN, the first sector of the high-density area (FAD 45150 on a GD-ROM, track03 of a Redump GDI). Area symbols at 0x30, product number at 0x40.

dc-product-id.description: Product number of IP.BIN (10 bytes at 0x40), trailing spaces cut and the value cut at a NUL, as flycast keys its per-game settings. The disk type at 0x25 reads 'MIL CD' on a MIL-CD disc.

sources.serial_note: Serials are written as the DAT writes them, and the DAT uses both forms: 'SLES-01971' and 'SLPS 02251' in the PlayStation DAT of the same day. A core reads the serial from the disc in its own spelling (SYSTEM.CNF holds 'SLPS_022.51', DuckStation reports 'SLPS-02251'). No source fixes a rule joining the two, so the comparison rule is the reader's to state.
